note: Chip edge cases: the empty state 'No class comments' and a literal '0 comments' are NOT a visible comment count (count stays null — humans see an empty thread, not a zero); filename tokens like 'comments.md'/'old-comments.txt' in the body are prose, not chips; and an aria-label-only chip ('7 comments' with no text content) must still be believed with count 7 because screen-reader users see it.
